diagnosis.hypothesis: Observed only web1-related IPv4 connectivity failing while app1 paths were healthy. Read fw-ext and found zone DMZ bound to eth3 even though web1 is on eth2 (dmz_web). Added eth2 to firewall zone DMZ on fw-ext with no policy loosening. Public success criteria then passed: all lab connectivity checks succeeded, including user1/guest1/external1 to web1 and return pings from web1.
diagnosis.reference: On the firewall fw-ext, interface eth2 was removed from zone DMZ, so traffic from DMZ to OUTSIDE is no longer matched by ruleset DMZ-TO-OUTSIDE and is dropped.

arguments.name: DMZ
arguments.reason: web1 is on eth2/dmz_web, but fw-ext zone DMZ contains eth3 instead of eth2; all web1 ICMP paths fail while app1 paths pass, implicating wrong DMZ zone interface membership without loosening policy

action.command: set firewall zone DMZ interface eth2
action.reason: web1 is on eth2/dmz_web, but fw-ext zone DMZ contains eth3 instead of eth2; all web1 ICMP paths fail while app1 paths pass, implicating wrong DMZ zone interface membership without loosening policy
